title: % v/v (Volume per Volume)

references.label: General microbiology/quantitative methods references (ASM, FDA BAM)

expression: % v/v = (volume of solute in mL / volume of final solution in mL) × 100
explanation: Expresses concentration as mL of a liquid solute (or liquid reagent) per 100 mL of final solution — common for describing liquid-in-liquid dilutions (e.g. '70% v/v ethanol').

variables.meaning: Volume of the liquid component being diluted

workedExample.scenario: 70 mL of pure ethanol brought to a final volume of 100 mL with water.

commonMistakes: Assuming volumes of two liquids are strictly additive when mixed — for some solvent pairs (notably ethanol/water) the true final volume can differ slightly from the simple sum, which matters for precise work.
